limitations: Fixed representative universe chosen in 2026; not a point-in-time whole-ETF universe.
Static comparator uses the same sizing, hard stop and trailing policy, not unconditional buy-and-hold.
Monthly version uses fixed equity/gold/bond representatives; weekly version ranks one asset per group.
All versions have identical 3-ATR entry stops, monotone 3-ATR trailing stops and gap stress sizing.
Daily OHLC execution is an approximation without auction depth; opening orders use prior-day liquidity capacity.
No production ETF action-value model exists; these rule portfolios must not receive DIRECT eligibility.
Study is exploratory; prior reviewed history is not a fresh holdout. Cash earns zero by assumption.
No strategy or threshold may be selected from this run and relabeled as an untouched holdout.
